services.booking_steps_des: Follow these steps to complete your facility booking
services.i1: Choose the type of service you want to book. Categories group related facilities together.
services.i2: Pick the exact facility within the chosen category. Each facility has different capacity, features, and pricing.
services.i3: Pick the dates and times you’d like to use the facility. You can select multiple days or specific time slots.
services.i4: Provide your organization’s details, contact person, and expected attendees. This ensures smooth communication.
services.i5: Double-check your chosen service, facility, dates, and details before submitting. You can save as a draft.
services.date_info: Select dates from the calendar to configure schedule
services.toggel: Toggle off to set specific time slots
services.info: Please attach a proper letter that clearly includes your organization name and a valid stamp.
services.desc1: Your booking request has been saved as a draft. You can review it anytime in the
services.desc3: tab, make changes if needed, and when you’re ready, submit it for approval.
services.desc5: Drafts let you prepare your booking details in advance. Don’t forget to return and submit your request when everything looks good.
services.not_messa: Your booking request will be reviewed by our team. You will receive an email confirmation within 24 hours. Payment will be processed only after approval.
services.booking_des: Track your service booking requests and payments
